marcado.f004: Do not tell me your name.
marcado.f008: You are in an unknown place.
marcado.f010: You do not know what it is.
marcado.p01.a.reacao: Interesting. You act before you think.
marcado.f011: It is never as simple as it seems.
marcado.p02.texto: What do you look for first?
marcado.p02.a.reacao: You read people before the place.
marcado.p02.b.reacao: You always know the way out.
marcado.f015: Someone you love is in danger.
marcado.f016: To save them, you will have to put other people at risk.
marcado.p03.a: I save the one I love.
marcado.f018: So that is what matters to you.
marcado.f019: You find a door that should never have been opened.
marcado.f020: On the other side lies an answer to everything you seek.
marcado.p04.c: First I try to find out who built the door.
marcado.f022: But that is for another time.
marcado.p05.c: I do not want to find out.
marcado.f025: When someone you love is about to die...
marcado.p06.texto: ...how far would you go to stop it?
marcado.p06.c: I would not sacrifice my humanity.
marcado.f027: But that is a matter for later.
marcado.f028: If you knew exactly the day you will die...
marcado.p07.c: Maybe it is better not to know.
marcado.f029: You want to know the end...
marcado.f032: You can change one single thing in the world.
marcado.f033: You do not know what will happen afterwards.
marcado.p08.c: It depends on what I could change.
marcado.f034: You like to play with things you do not understand.
marcado.f035: Let us leave that for later.
marcado.p09.b: From the countryside, where everyone knows each other.
marcado.p09.c: From a family whose weight I still carry.
marcado.p09.f: From places you only leave by surviving.
marcado.f039: You can follow a known path.
marcado.f040: Or you can create your own.
marcado.f048: I looked for what exists behind your choices.
marcado.f050: ...was able to tell who you really are.
marcado.f051: Because you do not belong to the answers.
marcado.f053: The chains of reality were not made for you.
marcado.f057: You can make your own choices.
marcado.f062: And discover what you will do with this freedom.
marcado.titulo.3: You are free of the chains of reality.
